name: MMOral-OPG-Bench
description:
🦷 [NeurIPS'25] MMOral-OPG-Bench
	

MMOral-Bench offers a curated evaluation suite for panoramic X-ray analysis. 
This benchmark consists of 100 images, paired with 491 closed-ended and 578 open-ended questions. 
All cases in MMOral-Bench are manually chosen and checked from the MMOral to ensure their quality and reliability.

	
		
		🚀 How to Use
	

You can explore and evaluate your model on MMOral-OPG-Bench easily.
